description: Retrieve a list of recurring items expected for a specified date range. The `matches` object on each item is populated based on the requested range and is null for suggested items.

end_date.description: End of the range used to populate `matches` (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be provided together with start_date.

include_suggested.description: If true, also returns recurring items suggested by the system that have not yet been reviewed. Suggested items do not update matching transactions until reviewed.

start_date.description: Start of the range used to populate `matches` (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the current month. Must be provided together with end_date.

name: get_recurring_items
